posts.name: MindWanderer
posts.cooked:
Even still, looks like many of the stretch goals will remain unmet.  It'll be interesting to see where Green Ronin and Handelabra go from there.  We know they're probably going to go ahead and make the oversized Argo and Meta-Mind villain cards, but no word on the hero variant cards (Raven, Pseudo, and probably Lady Liberty--we should hit Johnny Rocket).  Those are all fairly simple things, although art and playtesting are nontrivial; I'm guessing they really expected to reach those goals.  Maybe they'll hold off on those promo cards for future kickstarters or whatever.

As for the video game, I'm really surprised the stretch goal for that was so high.  Seems like a no-brainer for Handelabra, since they have the whole engine and all worked out already.  It would almost certainly be a better use of their time than developing a new IP for themselves.  It would be really surprising to me if they ultimately decided to just sit back and not do it, unless the card game tanks beyond belief.

posts.name: Natediggadoggity
posts.cooked:
Raven has "you may play a card" added to her base power. both Add-On heroes have: "One player may play a card or use a power" at the end of their power text, (even though they're likely to change to be differentiated a little more once they've actualy been designed)

 I think this is more of a refining of Chris's ability to design hero decks. You feel more like a team with your friends if you can get and give extra card plays, power, or draws, and you feel like you can be more effective if the villain or environment has punishing abilities that destroys your stuff or keeps you from playing or doing damage. I think it allows the villains to be more powerful overall as well.

I bet the "additional power, draw, or play" on hero powers will continue to be a theme in many of the Earth-Prime hero decks. The actual cards will probably have to be a little weaker in comparison, but it's a good design choice imo.

 

The later sentinels decks and variants have a lot more of those extra play or power effects as well.
